value.rationale: The exception-of-one-weight family is a canonical testing ground for numerical range geometry; Berger–Stampfli gives a meaningful Hilbert benchmark. The non-Hilbert smooth-duality structure produces two distinct exact thresholds rather than a routine restatement, with an attainment transition that characterizes the spatial numerical range boundary and a concrete p=3 orientation separation. It is a natural complete classification of the threshold question for the family, with plausible future use in numerical-range perturbation theory, without overclaiming closed supercritical formulas.
